Image mobjects

Source: R/image_mobject.R, R/zz_constructors.R
image_mobject.Rd

ImageMobject() displays a raster image from a PNG file or a numeric array with values from 0 to 255 (a matrix for grayscale, or an h x w x 3 or h x w x 4 array). Its corner points are, in order, upper left, upper right, lower left and lower right, so it moves, scales and rotates like any mobject. get_raster() returns an array in [0, 1] suitable for grid::grid.raster().

ImageMobjectFromCamera() shows what a MovingCameraClass camera sees; it is drawn by MultiCameraClass (see ZoomedScene).

Usage

ImageMobject(
  filename_or_array,
  scale_to_resolution = QUALITIES$high_quality$pixel_height,
  invert = FALSE,
  image_mode = "RGBA",
  ...
)

ImageMobjectFromCamera(camera, default_display_frame_config = NULL, ...)

AbstractImageMobject(
  scale_to_resolution,
  pixel_array_dtype = "uint8",
  resampling_algorithm = "bicubic",
  ...
)

Arguments

filename_or_array

Path to a PNG file (a single string), a numeric array, a raster from grDevices::as.raster(), a nativeRaster, or a character matrix of colors.

scale_to_resolution

Pixel height shown pixel for pixel, so the image height is nrow / scale_to_resolution * frame_height.

invert

Invert the image colors.

image_mode

Mode a PNG file is converted to after reading, as PIL does: "RGBA", "RGB" (drops the alpha channel) or "L" (luminance). Arrays and rasters are used as given. Images are then stored as RGBA, 0 to 255.

...

Further arguments for MobjectClass.

camera

A MovingCameraClass camera.

default_display_frame_config

List of style arguments for the frame added by add_display_frame().

pixel_array_dtype

Type of the stored pixel values; only "uint8" (0 to 255) is used.

resampling_algorithm

How the image is sampled when drawn: a name in RESAMPLING_ALGORITHMS, "bicubic" by default.

Examples

img <- ImageMobject(matrix(c(0, 100, 30, 200, 255, 0, 5, 33), 2, byrow = TRUE))
img$height <- 7
img$set_resampling_algorithm("nearest")
